name: orb
description: Calls, Gemini turns, brain turns, Gemini tools and personas, transcripts and errors of orb (docs/design/observability.md).

widgets.title: Calls
widgets.query: FROM Span SELECT count(*) AS 'calls' WHERE service.name = 'orb-voice' AND name = 'agent_session' SINCE 1 day ago COMPARE WITH 1 day ago

widgets.title: Average call length (s)
widgets.query: FROM Span SELECT average(duration.ms) / 1000 AS 'seconds' WHERE service.name = 'orb-voice' AND name = 'agent_session' SINCE 1 day ago

widgets.title: Model turns
widgets.query: FROM Span SELECT count(*) AS 'turns' WHERE service.name = 'orb-voice' AND name IN ('realtime_inference', 'llm_request') SINCE 1 day ago

widgets.title: Errors
widgets.query: FROM Log SELECT count(*) AS 'errors' WHERE service.name IN ('orb-voice', 'orb-agent') AND severity.text IN ('ERROR', 'CRITICAL') SINCE 1 day ago

widgets.title: Calls over time
widgets.query: FROM Span SELECT count(*) WHERE service.name = 'orb-voice' AND name = 'agent_session' SINCE 7 days ago TIMESERIES AUTO

widgets.title: Gemini turn time (ms): p50, p90
widgets.query: FROM Span SELECT percentile(duration.ms, 50, 90) WHERE service.name = 'orb-voice' AND name = 'realtime_inference' SINCE 1 day ago TIMESERIES AUTO

widgets.title: Gemini tokens
widgets.query: FROM Span SELECT sum(gen_ai.usage.input_tokens) AS 'input', sum(gen_ai.usage.output_tokens) AS 'output' WHERE service.name = 'orb-voice' AND name = 'realtime_inference' SINCE 1 day ago TIMESERIES AUTO

widgets.title: Voice worker stalls (event loop blocked)
widgets.query: FROM Span SELECT count(*) WHERE service.name = 'orb-voice' AND name = 'event_loop_blocked' FACET job_id SINCE 1 day ago LIMIT 10

widgets.title: Transcript (words only with ORB_LOG_TEXT=1)
widgets.query: FROM Log SELECT session, message AS 'who', text WHERE service.name = 'orb-voice' AND message IN ('user words', 'Gemini words') SINCE 1 day ago LIMIT 200

widgets.title: Warnings and errors
widgets.query: FROM Log SELECT service.name, severity.text, message WHERE service.name IN ('orb-voice', 'orb-agent') AND severity.text IN ('WARN', 'WARNING', 'ERROR', 'CRITICAL') AND message NOT LIKE 'event loop blocked%' SINCE 1 day ago LIMIT 100

widgets.title: Turns by persona
widgets.query: FROM Span SELECT count(*) WHERE service.name = 'orb-agent' AND name = 'orb.turn' FACET orb.persona SINCE 7 days ago

widgets.title: Turn steps (s): Jev read, LLM first token, LLM total
widgets.query: FROM Span SELECT average(orb.timing.read_human) AS 'Jev read', average(orb.timing.llm_first_token) AS 'LLM first token', average(orb.timing.llm_total) AS 'LLM total' WHERE service.name = 'orb-agent' AND name = 'orb.turn' SINCE 1 day ago TIMESERIES AUTO

widgets.title: Turns by channel
widgets.query: FROM Span SELECT count(*) WHERE service.name = 'orb-agent' AND name = 'orb.turn' FACET orb.channel SINCE 7 days ago

widgets.title: Debts paid (check done)
widgets.query: FROM Span SELECT count(*) WHERE service.name = 'orb-agent' AND name = 'orb.turn' AND orb.check_done IS NOT NULL FACET orb.check_done SINCE 7 days ago

widgets.title: Failed or cancelled turns
widgets.query: FROM Span SELECT filter(count(*), WHERE otel.status_code = 'ERROR') AS 'failed', filter(count(*), WHERE orb.cancelled IS TRUE) AS 'cancelled' WHERE service.name = 'orb-agent' AND name = 'orb.turn' SINCE 7 days ago

widgets.title: Turns (words only with ORB_LOG_TEXT=1)
widgets.query: FROM Span SELECT orb.session, orb.persona, orb.debt, orb.text, orb.reply, orb.timing.llm_total WHERE service.name = 'orb-agent' AND name = 'orb.turn' SINCE 1 day ago LIMIT 100

widgets.title: Requests by route
widgets.query: FROM Span SELECT count(*) WHERE service.name = 'orb-agent' AND span.kind = 'server' FACET name SINCE 1 day ago LIMIT 20

widgets.title: Route time (ms): p50, p95
widgets.query: FROM Span SELECT percentile(duration.ms, 50, 95), count(*) WHERE service.name = 'orb-agent' AND span.kind = 'server' FACET name SINCE 1 day ago LIMIT 20

widgets.title: Gemini turns (replies)
widgets.query: FROM Log SELECT count(*) AS 'turns' WHERE service.name = 'orb-voice' AND message = 'gemini turn' SINCE 1 day ago

widgets.title: Persona tool: called / skipped
widgets.query: FROM Log SELECT filter(count(*), WHERE called IS TRUE) AS 'called', filter(count(*), WHERE called IS FALSE) AS 'skipped' WHERE service.name = 'orb-voice' AND message = 'gemini turn' AND personas IS TRUE SINCE 1 day ago

widgets.title: Persona tool called (% of turns)
widgets.query: FROM Log SELECT percentage(count(*), WHERE called IS TRUE) AS 'called' WHERE service.name = 'orb-voice' AND message = 'gemini turn' AND personas IS TRUE SINCE 1 day ago

widgets.title: Google Search: turns that searched / queries
widgets.query: FROM Log SELECT filter(count(*), WHERE searched IS TRUE) AS 'turns', sum(searches) AS 'queries' WHERE service.name = 'orb-voice' AND message = 'gemini turn' SINCE 1 day ago

widgets.title: Persona note time (s)
widgets.query: FROM Log SELECT percentile(note_s, 50, 90) WHERE service.name = 'orb-voice' AND message = 'gemini turn' AND called IS TRUE AND note_error IS NULL SINCE 1 day ago

widgets.title: What each turn used
widgets.query: FROM Log SELECT count(*) WHERE service.name = 'orb-voice' AND message = 'gemini turn' FACET cases(WHERE called IS TRUE AND searched IS TRUE AS 'persona tool + search', WHERE called IS TRUE AS 'persona tool only', WHERE searched IS TRUE AS 'search only', WHERE personas IS TRUE AS 'no tool (personas on)', WHERE personas IS FALSE AS 'plain Gemini (personas off)') SINCE 1 day ago

widgets.title: Tools per minute
widgets.query: FROM Log SELECT filter(count(*), WHERE called IS TRUE) AS 'persona tool called', filter(count(*), WHERE personas IS TRUE AND called IS FALSE) AS 'persona tool skipped', filter(count(*), WHERE searched IS TRUE) AS 'searched' WHERE service.name = 'orb-voice' AND message = 'gemini turn' SINCE 1 day ago TIMESERIES AUTO

widgets.title: Persona tool called (%), by session
widgets.query: FROM Log SELECT percentage(count(*), WHERE called IS TRUE) WHERE service.name = 'orb-voice' AND message = 'gemini turn' AND personas IS TRUE FACET session SINCE 1 day ago LIMIT 20

widgets.title: Persona chosen (tool called)
widgets.query: FROM Log SELECT count(*) WHERE service.name = 'orb-voice' AND message = 'gemini turn' AND called IS TRUE AND note_error IS NULL FACET persona SINCE 1 day ago

widgets.title: Reply did the persona's job (%), by persona
widgets.query: FROM Log SELECT percentage(count(*), WHERE done IS TRUE) WHERE service.name = 'orb-voice' AND message = 'gemini turn' AND called IS TRUE AND note_error IS NULL AND done IS NOT NULL FACET persona SINCE 1 day ago

widgets.title: Problems
widgets.query: FROM Log SELECT filter(count(*), WHERE note_error IS NOT NULL) AS 'note failed (fallback used)', filter(count(*), WHERE cancelled IS TRUE) AS 'tool call cancelled', filter(count(*), WHERE calls > 1) AS 'tool called twice', filter(count(*), WHERE interrupted IS TRUE) AS 'reply interrupted', filter(count(*), WHERE match < 0.6) AS 'tool words differ from transcript' WHERE service.name = 'orb-voice' AND message = 'gemini turn' SINCE 1 day ago

widgets.title: Turns where Gemini skipped the persona tool (words only with ORB_LOG_TEXT=1)
widgets.query: FROM Log SELECT session, turn, heard AS 'you said', reply AS 'Gemini said', persona AS 'persona chosen after' WHERE service.name = 'orb-voice' AND message = 'gemini turn' AND personas IS TRUE AND called IS FALSE SINCE 1 day ago LIMIT 200

widgets.title: Turns that searched Google
widgets.query: FROM Log SELECT session, turn, heard AS 'you said', queries AS 'searched for', called AS 'persona tool', reply AS 'Gemini said' WHERE service.name = 'orb-voice' AND message = 'gemini turn' AND searched IS TRUE SINCE 1 day ago LIMIT 200

widgets.title: Every turn
widgets.query: FROM Log SELECT session, turn, called, calls, persona, stage, done, searched, searches, note_s, match, cancelled, interrupted, note_error, heard, asked, queries, reply WHERE service.name = 'orb-voice' AND message = 'gemini turn' SINCE 1 day ago LIMIT 500

widgets.title: Tool errors in the logs
widgets.query: FROM Log SELECT session, message, error, function_call_ids WHERE service.name = 'orb-voice' AND message IN ('persona note failed: Gemini replies without one', 'Gemini reply not recorded', 'server cancelled tool calls') SINCE 1 day ago LIMIT 100
